svg.title: CoMem Write–Select–Read architecture
svg.desc: Context chunks are written once to a persistent split-depth store, a query selects a bounded top-k subset, and the selected cached residuals resume only the upper transformer layers. The figure compares raw-text j equals zero replay with cached h sub j continuation and includes an overlap-Write context variant.

g.text: CoMem: persistent Write – bounded Select – depth-reused Read
Write each context chunk once; every query touches only a fixed top-k pack.
prepend document-left context; cache only the target chunk
Longer one-time Write; identical store bytes and Read pack.
rank keys across N stored chunks
Read length = sink + k · c + query — independent of stored-context length N
Same selected chunk IDs and causal pack; only the split endpoint changes
query q traverses lower [0 : j) once
CoMem skips repeated lower-layer document compute; only the bounded top-k pack enters Read.
